text:
lina: Heads-up: APAC-friendly launch webinar tomorrow 8pm SGT (12pm PT). We need: localized registration copy, timezone routing for reminders, translated captions (EN, JP, KR), recording fallback plan, and post-event nurture with region-specific CTAs.

rahul: I can take localization for JP/KR registration copy. Will need final CTAs from product by EOD. Also propose adding a field on the reg form: preferred-language.

erin: I'll own reminder cadence + timezone routing. Plan: 24h, 1h, 10m local time reminders. For attendees in +8/+9/+10 zones, send reminders in local language if pref-lang set.

sam: Zoom questions: should we enable cloud recording to multiple regions? Zoom only stores in one region; we should copy to S3 us-west-2 and ap-northeast-1 after upload. Ops can set cross-region sync.

marco: Video ops: we'll record gallery + shared screen + separate audio tracks. Also recommend hitting "Enable original sound" for the demo machine. For fallback, we'll run OBS RTMP backup to rtmp://backup.redwood.com/launch-apac.

ops-bot: deploy: rtmp_backup_rule created -> target: rtmp://backup.redwood.com/launch-apac, retention: 30d

lina: Registration page: simplify hero copy for mobile. Use two CTAs: "Watch live (apac-friendly time)" and "Get replay". Add hidden utm_region=apac on submit. Rahul, can you confirm translated CTAs?

rahul: Confirmed. JP copy: "ライブに参加する" / リプレイ希望: "リプレイを受け取る". KR copy: "라이브 참여" / "리플레이 받기". Will drop in the sheet.

erin: Reminder emails: subject line variant A (localized): "Redwood Launch — starts at {local_time}". Variant B (eng): "Join our launch". We'll A/B where pref-lang unset. Also track open -> HubSpot contact prop 'apac_reminder_opened'.

sam: On captions: Zoom auto-CC is ok for quick live captions but we must generate human-reviewed translations after the event. Plan: 1) export raw VTT from Zoom, 2) run internal translation pipeline -> produce en.ja.srt, en.ko.srt, and a merged multi-language VTT. Store under s3://redwood-marketing/apac-launch/captions/.

marco: Clips: priority list = 1) 90s demo highlight, 2) 45s benchmark nugget, 3) 30s CTA snippet. Add metadata: region_tag=apac, language=ja/ko/en. Deliver to comms by +48h.

ops-bot: upload: recording 3769123600 uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/apac-launch/recordings/3769123600.mp4

erin: Post-event nurture plan: immediate replay email (local times included), 48h localized clips drip, 5d follow-up with region-specific case study, 12d sales outreach for leads with engagement >50%. Tracking: watched_replay and clip_engagement props.

lina: HubSpot routing rule: if company HQ in APAC -> assign to APAC SDR queue. If pref-language=ja -> tag contact 'ja_pref'. Also send event payload to Segment with region=apac. Alex from infra said webhook schema matches current.

rahul: Small ask: include a short reg question: "Which deployment matters most?" choices: Hosted / Dedicated / Private. That will help prioritize APAC demo follow-ups.

sam: For editors: I'll create markers in the editor sheet referencing the VTT timestamps as soon as transcription finishes. Will also flag low-quality auto-cc segments for manual correction.

marco: Greenroom checklist: 1) confirm bandwidth (10mbps uplink), 2) demo machine audio loopback test, 3) panelist name display, 4) backup recording in OBS. Greenroom check @7:20pm SGT.

erin: Analytics hook: replay-click -> Segment track 'replay_clicked' with properties {utm_region, language, timestamp}. We'll map to HubSpot contact timeline event. I will add payload example in the ops sheet.

ops-bot: transcribe: job tx-3769123700 started -> outputs: raw_vtt, speaker_segments, confidence_scores

lina: Final QA: please update the region triage sheet within 4 hours of event end with clip owners, translations, and HubSpot tags. I'll verify at 10am PT tomorrow. If anything breaks ping #marketing-ops and @lina. :rocket:

rahul: I'll upload JP/KR landing copy and CTAs to the sheet now.

marco: I'll stand by for greenroom and monitor RTMP backup.

sam: Good to go from Zoom config.
